questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}f_\zeta(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\varphi(x,y)dy&=\begin{cases}\int_{0}^{+\infty}\dfrac{6}{\left(1+x+y\right)^4}dy, & x\geq 0\\0, & x<0\end{cases}=\begin{cases}\dfrac{2}{\left(1+x\right)^3},\ x\geq 0\\0, & x<0\end{cases},\\F_\zeta(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}\varphi(x,y)dy&=\begin{cases}\int_{0}^{x}\dfrac{2}{\left(1+t\right)^t}dy, & x\geq 0\\0, & x<0\end{cases}=\begin{cases}1-\dfrac{1}{\left(1+x\right)^2},\ x\geq 0\\0, & x<0\end{cases}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}(1) & \text{当}x<-R\text{或}x>R\text{时，}f_{x}(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)dy=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}0dy=0;\\& \text{当}-R\leq x\leq R\text{时，}f_{x}(x)=\int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}f(x,y)dy=\frac{1}{\pi R^{2}}\int_{-\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}}^{\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}}dy=\frac{2}{\pi R^{2}}\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}.\\& \text{于是，}f_{x}(x)=\begin{cases}\frac{2\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}}{\pi R^{2}},&-R\leq x\leq R\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}.\\& \text{由于}x\text{和}y\text{的地位平等，同法可得}y\text{的边缘概率密度}\\& f_{y}(y)=\begin{cases}\frac{2\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}}{\pi R^{2}},&-R\leq y\leq R\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}2) & \text{当}-R<y<R\text{时，}f_{xy}(x|y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_{y}(y)}\\& \text{注意在}y\text{处}x\text{值位于}|x|\leq\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}\text{这个范围内，此时}f(x,y)\neq 0\text{，有}\\& f_{xy}(x|y)=\frac{\frac{1}{\pi R^{2}}}{\frac{2}{\pi R^{2}}\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}},\\& \text{故当}-R<y<R\text{时，}X\text{的条件概率密度为}\\& f_{xy}(x|y)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}},&|x|\leq\sqrt{R^{2}-y^{2}}\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}\\& \text{同理，当}-R<x<R\text{时，}Y\text{的条件概率密度为}\\& f_{yX}(x|x)=\begin{cases}\frac{1}{2\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}},&|y|\leq\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}\\0,&\text{其它}\end{cases}\\& \text{由于条件概率密度与边缘概率密度不相等，所以}X\text{与}Y\text{不独立.}\end{aligned}
